headline: Brazil stocks jump 4% following reports of potential finance minister candidate
summary: Brazil's main stock index jumped about 4% after reports that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva sounded out banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco for the role of finance minister.
why: Expectations around key economic cabinet appointments influence investor sentiment regarding fiscal policy direction and market stability.

impacts.name: BOVESPA
impacts.why: The index tracks the most liquid stocks traded on the B3 exchange in Brazil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market sentiment improved following reports connecting a respected banking figure to a potential cabinet post.
